import uuid

import pytest
from fastapi import HTTPException

from core.sql_first.connection_factory import get_edarsahub_pymssql_connection
from modules.cava_socios import routes
from modules.cava_socios.report_service import get_cava_report_service
from modules.cava_socios.service import get_cava_socios_service


JOB_ID = "CAVAS-GATE13B-E2E-CONTROLLED-UAT-R1-20260918"
SOCIO_ID = "62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58"
UNIDAD_ID = "19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C"
SECOND_AUTHORIZED_UNIT = "23CA0B76-6580-4874-BA9B-672B122CA197"
UNAUTHORIZED_UNIT = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555"
PUBLIC_UUID = "A72B325B-662F-4777-83ED-4DDA6E8398A8"
EMAIL = "noxte@alpyc.com"


def _conn():
    return get_edarsahub_pymssql_connection(timeout=30, login_timeout=10)


def _snapshot():
    conn = _conn()
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor(as_dict=True)
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                CONVERT(varchar(36), SocioID) AS SocioID,
                CONVERT(varchar(36), EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,
                NumeroSocio,
                PersonaID,
                ClienteCRMID,
                FechaModificacion,
                CONVERT(varchar(36), UsuarioModificacionID) AS UsuarioModificacionID
            FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios
            WHERE SocioID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s
            """,
            (SOCIO_ID, UNIDAD_ID),
        )
        socio = cur.fetchone()
        assert socio is not None, "GATE13B_SOCIO_CANARY_NOT_FOUND"

        counts = {}
        for key, sql in {
            "botellas": "SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas WHERE SocioID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s",
            "movimientos": "SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos WHERE SocioID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s",
            "cargos": "SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos WHERE SocioID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s",
        }.items():
            cur.execute(sql, (SOCIO_ID, UNIDAD_ID))
            counts[key] = int(cur.fetchone()["n"])

        return {"socio": dict(socio), **counts}
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _cleanup(marker, botella_id, persona_rfc, before):
    conn = _conn()
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor(as_dict=True)

        if botella_id:
            cur.execute(
                "DELETE FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos WHERE BotellaID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s",
                (botella_id, UNIDAD_ID),
            )
            cur.execute(
                "DELETE FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos WHERE BotellaID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s",
                (botella_id, UNIDAD_ID),
            )
            cur.execute(
                "DELETE FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas WHERE BotellaID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s",
                (botella_id, UNIDAD_ID),
            )

        cur.execute(
            "SELECT PersonaID FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona WHERE RFC=%s",
            (persona_rfc,),
        )
        persona = cur.fetchone()
        persona_id = int(persona["PersonaID"]) if persona else None

        if persona_id is not None:
            cur.execute(
                """
                UPDATE dbo.CavaSocios_Socios
                   SET PersonaID=NULL
                 WHERE SocioID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s AND PersonaID=%s
                """,
                (SOCIO_ID, UNIDAD_ID, persona_id),
            )
            cur.execute(
                "DELETE FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo WHERE PersonaID=%s",
                (persona_id,),
            )
            cur.execute(
                "DELETE FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona WHERE PersonaID=%s",
                (persona_id,),
            )

        cur.execute(
            """
            UPDATE dbo.CavaSocios_Socios
               SET PersonaID=%s,
                   ClienteCRMID=%s,
                   FechaModificacion=%s,
                   UsuarioModificacionID=%s
             WHERE SocioID=%s AND EmpresaID=%s
            """,
            (
                before["socio"]["PersonaID"],
                before["socio"]["ClienteCRMID"],
                before["socio"]["FechaModificacion"],
                before["socio"]["UsuarioModificacionID"],
                SOCIO_ID,
                UNIDAD_ID,
            ),
        )

        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _assert_no_residue(marker, persona_rfc, before):
    after = _snapshot()
    assert after["botellas"] == before["botellas"]
    assert after["movimientos"] == before["movimientos"]
    assert after["cargos"] == before["cargos"]
    assert after["socio"]["PersonaID"] == before["socio"]["PersonaID"]
    assert after["socio"]["ClienteCRMID"] == before["socio"]["ClienteCRMID"]

    conn = _conn()
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor(as_dict=True)
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona WHERE RFC=%s", (persona_rfc,))
        assert int(cur.fetchone()["n"]) == 0
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas WHERE ProductoNombre=%s AND EmpresaID=%s",
            (marker, UNIDAD_ID),
        )
        assert int(cur.fetchone()["n"]) == 0
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _contains_value(value, needle):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return any(_contains_value(v, needle) for v in value.values())
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return any(_contains_value(v, needle) for v in value)
    return str(value).lower() == str(needle).lower()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_gate13b_e2e_controlled_full_flow_and_cleanup():
    before = _snapshot()
    assert before["socio"]["PersonaID"] is None
    assert before["socio"]["ClienteCRMID"] is None
    assert before["socio"]["NumeroSocio"] == "SOC-00001"

    current_user = {
        "id": PUBLIC_UUID,
        "public_uuid": PUBLIC_UUID,
        "email": EMAIL,
    }

    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
    marker = f"UAT13B-{suffix[:12]}"
    rfc = ("UAT13B" + suffix[:7])[:13]
    curp = ("UAT13B" + suffix[:12])[:18]

    botella_id = None

    try:
        dashboard_before = await routes.get_dashboard(
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert "socios" in dashboard_before
        assert "botellas" in dashboard_before
        assert "financiero" in dashboard_before

        socios = await routes.listar_socios(
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            estatus="ACTIVO",
            skip=0,
            limit=100,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert _contains_value(socios, SOCIO_ID)

        socio = await routes.obtener_socio(
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert socio["numero_socio"] == "SOC-00001"

        other_unit = await routes.listar_socios(
            unidad_negocio_pk=SECOND_AUTHORIZED_UNIT,
            estatus=None,
            skip=0,
            limit=100,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert not _contains_value(other_unit, SOCIO_ID)

        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as forbidden:
            await routes.obtener_socio(
                socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
                unidad_negocio_pk=UNAUTHORIZED_UNIT,
                current_user=current_user,
            )
        assert forbidden.value.status_code == 403

        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as missing:
            await routes.obtener_socio(
                socio_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
                current_user=current_user,
            )
        assert missing.value.status_code == 404

        persona_payload = routes.PersonaCreateLinkRequest(
            nombre="UAT Gate13B",
            apellido_paterno="EDARSAHUB",
            rfc=rfc,
            curp=curp,
            nacionalidad="MX",
            cliente_id=None,
        )
        created_persona = await routes.crear_persona_y_vincular(
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            data=persona_payload,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert created_persona["created_persona"] is True
        persona_id = int(created_persona["persona_id"])

        linked = await routes.obtener_persona_link(
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert int(linked["persona_id"]) == persona_id

        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as conflict:
            await routes.crear_persona_y_vincular(
                socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
                data=routes.PersonaCreateLinkRequest(
                    nombre="UAT Gate13B Duplicate",
                    apellido_paterno="EDARSAHUB",
                    rfc=("U13BD" + suffix[:8])[:13],
                    curp=("U13BD" + suffix[:13])[:18],
                    nacionalidad="MX",
                    cliente_id=None,
                ),
                unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
                current_user=current_user,
            )
        assert conflict.value.status_code == 409

        bottle = await routes.registrar_botella(
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            data=routes.BotellaCreate(
                producto_nombre=marker,
                producto_codigo=marker,
                marca="EDARSAHUB-UAT",
                tipo_bebida="VINO_TINTO",
                añada="2026",
                capacidad=1.0,
                nivel_actual=100.0,
                ubicacion="UAT13B",
                valor_declarado=999.99,
                observaciones=JOB_ID,
            ),
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        botella_id = str(bottle["botella_id"])
        assert botella_id

        inventario = await routes.obtener_inventario(
            ubicacion=None,
            tipo_bebida=None,
            estatus=None,
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            skip=0,
            limit=100,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert _contains_value(inventario, botella_id)
        assert _contains_value(inventario, marker)

        hoja = await routes.obtener_hoja_inventario_fisico(
            ubicacion=None,
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert _contains_value(hoja, botella_id)

        consumo = await routes.registrar_consumo(
            botella_id=botella_id,
            data=routes.ConsumoCreate(
                porcentaje_consumido=25.0,
                motivo=JOB_ID,
                generar_cargo_descorche=True,
                monto_descorche=123.45,
                observaciones=marker,
            ),
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert float(consumo["nivel_anterior"]) == 100.0
        assert float(consumo["nivel_nuevo"]) == 75.0
        assert consumo["tipo_movimiento"] == "CONSUMO_PARCIAL"
        assert consumo["cargo_id"] is not None

        kardex = await routes.obtener_kardex(
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            botella_id=botella_id,
            fecha_inicio=None,
            fecha_fin=None,
            tipo_movimiento=None,
            skip=0,
            limit=100,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert _contains_value(kardex, botella_id)
        assert _contains_value(kardex, "CONSUMO_PARCIAL")

        consumos = await routes.obtener_consumos(
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            skip=0,
            limit=100,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert _contains_value(consumos, botella_id)
        assert _contains_value(consumos, marker)

        dashboard_after = await routes.get_dashboard(
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert int(dashboard_after["botellas"]["total"]) >= int(dashboard_before["botellas"]["total"]) + 1
        assert int(dashboard_after["financiero"]["cargos_pendientes"]) >= int(dashboard_before["financiero"]["cargos_pendientes"]) + 1

        service = get_cava_socios_service()
        report_service = get_cava_report_service()
        socio_report = service.obtener_socio(SOCIO_ID, UNIDAD_ID)
        movimientos_report = service.obtener_movimientos_socio(SOCIO_ID, UNIDAD_ID)
        cargos_report = service.obtener_cargos_socio(SOCIO_ID, UNIDAD_ID)

        ficha_pdf = report_service.generar_ficha_socio(socio_report)
        consumos_pdf = report_service.generar_historial_consumos(socio_report, movimientos_report)
        estado_pdf = report_service.generar_estado_cuenta(socio_report, cargos_report)

        for pdf in (ficha_pdf, consumos_pdf, estado_pdf):
            assert isinstance(pdf, (bytes, bytearray))
            assert bytes(pdf).startswith(b"%PDF")
            assert len(pdf) > 500

        unlinked = await routes.desvincular_persona(
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert int(unlinked["persona_id_anterior"]) == persona_id
        assert unlinked["canonical_records_deleted"] is False

        final_link = await routes.obtener_persona_link(
            socio_id=SOCIO_ID,
            unidad_negocio_pk=UNIDAD_ID,
            current_user=current_user,
        )
        assert final_link["persona_id"] is None

    finally:
        _cleanup(marker, botella_id, rfc, before)

    _assert_no_residue(marker, rfc, before)

Delete only UAT-created Persona, PersonaVinculo, bottle, movement and cargo rows
Restore SOC-00001 PersonaID, ClienteCRMID, FechaModificacion and UsuarioModificacionID to baseline
